verdict.rationale: Glama says every server in its directory is "scanned, scored" and markets the ability to "search, compare" servers. Community users corroborate a published TDQS quality score with letter grades (e.g. A), and a claim-panel token supports verified ownership. Some users reported the score retest failing to re-trigger because of an undocumented credit requirement. That is a refresh-workflow friction, not evidence the scores are absent. Missing for 10: evidence of usage counts or health/liveness checks, first-party documentation of the scoring methodology, and evidence of how verification badges appear when comparing servers.
